# Page content map

**What this is:** a page-by-page plan for the 16 new subpages. For each page it records which original content goes where, the section structure, and the copy the site uses. Product lists are complete.

**How it's produced:** generated by `npm run docs:content-map` from `src/site/data/catalogue.ts`, `src/site/data/pages.ts` and `src/site/data/products.generated.ts`, the same modules the pages render. If the copy changes, rerun the script and this document stays accurate.

**Sources:** `docs/source-content-inventory.md` (live site, 18 Nov 2026) and the earlier audit, rechecked against the live site.
**Open questions:** `docs/client-content-needed.md`.

## Writing rules applied

1. Rewrite, don't duplicate: the original wording was tightened, typos fixed, and repetition between pages removed.
2. Category introductions are written at category level (what the product family is and how buyers use it). No grades, specifications, packaging, MOQ, origin, capacity, shelf life, certifications, destinations or prices are stated unless they appear in the published product name.
3. Company claims appear only where the site already publishes them (direct sourcing, inspection, documentation, FOB/CFR/CIF, India and Dubai offices, four directors and their published roles). The unverified homepage stats (5000+, 15+, 20+, 4.9) and the certification logos are **not** used on the subpages.
4. Every product name on the original site appears exactly once on its category page, in source order within its group.

## URL map

| New page | New URL | Original URL (redirects to new) |
|---|---|---|
| About Us | `/about-us` | `/about-us/` (same path) |
| Products Overview | `/products` | `/product/` |
| Agriculture Overview | `/products/agriculture` | `/agriculture-product-page/` |
| Fruits & Vegetables | `/products/agriculture/fruits-vegetables` | `/fruits-vegetables/` |
| Dry Spices | `/products/agriculture/dry-spices` | `/dry-spices/` |
| Grains, Pulses & Cereals | `/products/agriculture/grains-pulses-cereals` | `/grains/` |
| Frozen Vegetables | `/products/agriculture/frozen-vegetables` | `/frozen-vegetables/` |
| Dried & Dehydrated | `/products/agriculture/dried-dehydrated` | `/dried-dehydrated/` |
| Cocopeat | `/products/agriculture/cocopeat` | `/cocopeat/` |
| Makhana | `/products/agriculture/makhana` | `/makhana/` |
| Nuts & Seeds | `/products/nuts-seeds` | `/nuts-seeds/` |
| Textile | `/products/textile` | `/textile/` and the broken `/textile-2/` |
| Pharmaceuticals | `/products/pharmaceuticals` | `/pharmaceuticals/` |
| EXIM Training | `/exim-training` | `/exim-training/` (same path) |
| Gallery | `/gallery` | `/gallery/` (same path) |
| Contact Us | `/contact` | `/contact/` (same path) |

Redirects run in the app (React Router). For production, the host needs a single-page-app fallback (every path serves `index.html`); server-side 301s for the old URLs are recommended for SEO.

## Source issues corrected

- The Agriculture index's travel-template block is removed.
- Frozen Vegetables is labelled correctly (the original label said "Dry Spices").
- The Textile link goes to the real catalogue; `/textile-2/` redirects there.
- Wrong product alt text (for example "Cluster Beans" on rice) is replaced with the product name.
- Placeholder content is removed: director pop-up placeholders, 0% counters, footer "construction business" text, theme-vendor social links.
- "Musterd", "Vission", "Yout", "Commodites" and "Pratibhasyam" are corrected. The footer email typo is replaced with the Contact-page address.
- EXIM FAQ: "AD Overseas" is removed, and the email address is no longer described as a website.
